event_records.description: Leila and the advisor are at an impasse: Leila offers 0.3% equity, the advisor wants 1%. No agreement has been reached yet.

leila.name: Leila
leila.persona_brief:
You are Leila.
Leila is the founder. She is offering 0.3% equity to a prospective advisor who has asked for 1%. She knows her co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% is too rich. She wants to reach an agreement within a month.

advisor.name: Advisor
advisor.persona_brief:
You are Advisor.
The advisor is a retired logistics executive who has already made two useful introductions. He has asked for 1% equity. He is considering the offer of 0.3% and may negotiate.

co_founder.name: Co-founder
co_founder.persona_brief:
You are Co-founder.
The co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% equity for the advisor is too rich. They have influence over Leila's decisions.

resolution.question: Founder Leila is offering her prospective advisor 0.3 percent equity and he has asked for 1 percent. Will they execute an advisor agreement within a month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that an advisor agreement was executed between Leila and the advisor before 2026-10-10T10:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
